prompt.title: Explain How The Finding Supports Your Action
prompt.text: Explain how the GuardDuty-style finding supports your selected response action. Connect the finding details to the incident response decision.

learner_justification.transcript: I selected Confirm Detection Scope and used GuardDuty Scope Finding. This guardduty evidence is expected to act as strong support for the decision. I am checking whether the screenshot clearly shows the affected identity, source IP, event timing, service, status, and risk signal. If those details do not directly prove the response action, I would treat it as incomplete context and compare it with another evidence source.

coach_output.feedback: Great work identifying the GuardDuty finding! It's clear from the summary that you're focusing on the critical aspects of the finding—such as the principal (admin-test), remote IP (185.220.101.42), severity (High), and the time frame (from October 1st). However, remember to also look at any potential secondary findings or indicators of compromise (IoCs) that could expand the scope of the incident. For now, let’s move forward with using this information to determine if the incident is isolated or part of a larger attack. What else can you think about?
coach_output.next_turn_guidance: Consider reviewing any other security tools or logs to see if there are any additional IoCs that could help confirm or extend the scope of the detected threat. Also, keep an eye out for any patterns or anomalies in future detections that might indicate further investigation into the broader impact of the incident.
